review_candidates.title: Administrative Coordinators
review_candidates.description: Work for the IMF. Work for the World. We are seeking motivated, detail-oriented professionals with strong office administration, proofreading, and technology skills to join our pool of prospective Administrative Coordinators to support teams at our Washington, D.C. Headquarters. Key Responsibilities Administrative Coordinators provide wide-ranging operational, communication, and logistical support to their divisions. Key responsibilities include: Document Production and Quality Assurance: compiling, formatting, and editing documents, ranging from correspondence to lengthy reports, according to IMF style guidelines; proofreading for clarity, accuracy, grammar, and adherence to institutional standards; integrating charts, tables, figures, and statistical outputs into polished publications. Internal Review and Workflow Management: coordinating the internal review process of a wide range of documents; monitoring review mailboxes, distributing materials to reviewers, and tracking deadlines; organizing, formatting, and posting consolidated review comments on behalf of the team. Operational and Logistical Coordination: managing official travel logistics, including travel authorizations and expense reports; supporting the planning and delivery of seminars, workshops, and conferences at Headquarters and overseas by arranging venues, catering, materials, and participant support; maintaining accurate, well-organized electronic filing systems and retrieving documents from internal repositories. Communication and Scheduling: managing complex calendars, scheduling meetings, and coordinating communications within the Fund and with officials from member countries; disseminating and reinforcing administrative policies and procedures across the division to ensure compliance. Technical and Systems Support: providing first-line support to colleagues for Fund systems and office technologies; troubleshooting basic issues and guiding staff through system processes. Qualifications And Competencies We are seeking candidates who demonstrate professionalism, accuracy, and a commitment to service excellence. Qualified applicants should bring: A bachelor’s degree or a high school diploma with at least two years of relevant experience. Applicants with 2–5 years of administrative coordination experience are strongly encouraged to apply. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Exceptional English proofreading and document formatting ability, including working with style guides. Outstanding organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities. Initiative, resourcefulness, and the ability to work with minimal supervision. High accuracy and attention to detail in fast-paced, deadline-driven settings. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and a willingness to learn evolving technologies. We value the diverse backgrounds and perspectives Administrative Coordinators bring to the Fund. We are especially interested in candidates who are native speakers of Arabic, Chinese, French, Portuguese, Russian, or Spanish. Selection Process Only candidates who are currently residing in the Washington DC metro area will be considered. Candidates for this position must pass the online Administrative Coordinator assessment. If your application meets the minimum qualifications, and you have not taken the assessment within the past 12 months, you will receive a link to an online assessment which you will need to complete within 10 days. The assessment is comprised of scenario-based multiple-choice questions, MS Word simulation, and Windows and normally takes approximately 50 minutes to complete. Candidates who pass the assessment may be invited to a preliminary interview. Successful applicants may enter our active candidate pipeline. Hiring managers across the Fund may invite you to interview for open roles for a period of six months after entering the pipeline. Selected candidates will typically receive a contractual appointment. Contractual appointments at the IMF are renewable for up to four years of cumulative contractual service, pending incumbent's performance, budget availability, and continuous business needs. Joining the Fund offers hands-on exposure to our systems, processes, and global mission—valuable experience for future career growth. Department: Hiring For: A03, A04 The IMF is guided by the principle that the employment, classification, promotion, and assignment of staff shall be made without discrimination against any person. We welcome requests for reasonable accommodations for disabilities during the selection process. Information on how to request accommodations will be provided during the application process.

review_candidates.title: Vice President, Global Brand Operations
review_candidates.description: Your Opportunity at ARC'TERYX: As the Vice President, Global Brand Operations, you will define and lead the operational vision for the brand and marketing function globally, ensuring alignment with our Long-Term Strategic Plan and broader business objectives. You will drive marketing and creative innovation, modernize the operating model to deliver greater agility and personalization, and shape a future-focused global operations team that enables the brand to remain deeply authentic while delivering greater impact at scale. You will play a critical role on the global brand leadership team, driving consumer-led process transformation as we continue to grow rapidly into a global brand — leading a talented internal team, evolving operational excellence across key functional areas worldwide, and building the systemic cohesion that powers the entire brand organization. You bring deep expertise in building, scaling, and transforming global marketing operations at a high-growth company, at pace and at scale — one that accelerates marketing effectiveness and optimizes ROI across channels and regions. You will lead and integrate the global teams responsible for Go-to-Market execution, Creative Operations and Services, Marketing Project Management, and Campaign Management, partnering closely with regional marketing teams to ensure global-to-local alignment and effective delivery across all markets. This role is based out of our North Vancouver office. Meet Your Future Team: The Brand Operations team is a highly committed, and collaborative global group of Producers, Project Managers, and Operators responsible for defining and evolving processes, leading workflow, and the end-to-end production of ecommerce content, brand and product campaigns, and projects — working in close partnership with cross-functional teams across the organization. If you were the Vice President, Global Brand Operations now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing: Setting the global Brand Operations strategy and operating model — establishing and evolving the long-term vision and roadmap in line with the Long-Term Strategic Plan; defining the operational standards, frameworks, and ways of working that regional leaders adopt globally to ensure GTM, creative, project, and campaign work is planned and executed consistently while enabling locally relevant delivery Exploring and evolving the global x regional operating model to support brand and business objectives Modernizing the marketing operating model for agility and personalization at scale — leading the transformation of processes, tools, and ways of working to increase speed-to-market, enable data-driven and personalized campaign execution, and build a more agile, tech-enabled function fit for a high-growth global brand Owning end-to-end Go-to-Market, Creative Services, and Project Management execution — partnering with senior Brand leaders on calendaring, resource planning, and cross-functional gates; ensuring creative infrastructure, workflows, vendor relationships, and resourcing models deliver best-in-class output globally; and driving enterprise-level clarity, accountability, and reporting across all major brand initiatives Leading Campaign Management and the Brand Operations technology stack — ensuring integrated campaigns are planned, resourced, and executed with rigor from brief through performance tracking, while owning the project management, workflow, and digital asset management (DAM) platforms that power the function, including governance of asset rights, usage, and licensing compliance Managing the Brand Operations P&L and global vendor/agency ecosystem — optimizing operational spend against strategic priorities in partnership with FP&A; and leading agency and vendor strategy including roster management, RFP/tender processes, contract negotiation, and performance reviews Driving global-to-regional alignment and governance — developing and implementing consistent Brand Operations standards across channels and markets worldwide. Establishing processes which support and enable global brand cohesion with local relevance, including global, regional and local marketing ways of working. Also responsible to maintain an enterprise-wide view of operational risk and dependencies; and establishing a clear process for managing urgent or reactive requests without derailing planned workflows Building organizational capability and driving continuous improvement — overseeing and developing a high-performing global team; leading change management and process redesign to increase agility and reduce cost; presenting business reviews and recommendations to senior leadership; and using an operations scorecard (throughput, cost-per-asset, campaign velocity, budget variance) and analytics to improve resource allocation and decision-making, incorporating responsible production practices where relevant Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future: Evaluating and integrating emerging technologies — including AI-powered production tools, workflow automation, and campaign management platforms Leading the development of a globally scalable brand operating framework that supports new markets, categories, or business models Future-proofing the operations model through real-time campaign optimization, data-driven resource allocation, and agile cross-functional delivery Are you our next Vice President, Global Brand Operations? review_candidates.title: Territory Sales Manager, South of Finland | Orthopaedic Instruments
review_candidates.description: The Job’s Mission: As Territory Sales Manager , you will help us deliver on our mission of making healthcare better by promoting and selling Stryker’s Orthopaedic Instruments product portfolio – covering the South of Finland . Our innovative Orthopaedic Instruments portfolio includes capital and consumable products created to help healthcare professionals do their best work every time. Find out more details about our devices and services via this link: https://www.stryker.com/us/en/orthopaedic-instruments.html In this role, you will pursue opportunities to grow our Orthopaedic Instruments business while demonstrating exemplary customer and patient focus. This is a great opportunity to join one of the world’s leading medical technology organizations, make an impact and develop further in your career ! What you will do: In your new role, you will start with a familiarization phase with training to learn about our product portfolio and develop relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Prospect new customers, understand their needs, while also providing ongoing service to existing customers: fostering trust relationships, customer loyalty and sales growth. Develop and execute business plans. You will implement strategies in the sales process and conduct negotiations including with hospital professionals, purchasing departments, etc. With the product knowledge you’ll develop, you will inform, advise and train hospital professionals during workshops and presentations. You will also provide clinical support in the operating room when needed. Support in tenders, prepare quotes for interested customers and be a reliable partner for our customers during order follow-up and after-sales Participate in congresses, seminars and business meetings to identify potential new customers and to expand your knowledge for customer contact. Collaborate with internal teams to deliver excellent customer experience – and with colleagues from other Stryker Commercial divisions towards cross-departmental opportunities. What you need: Required: 4+ years of overall experience, including sales experience. Degree or equivalent, preferably in fields such as business, physiotherapy, nursing, healthcare or in any other relevant areas. Excellent interpersonal communications and persuasion skills – with proficiency in Finnish and English. Commercial and financial acumen: you are enthusiastic about medical technology – your resilience and desire to sell technical products with the best customer service are important elements to you. Relationship skills: you appreciate contact with a wide variety of people and enjoy building and maintaining connections. You also consider yourself a great team player. You demonstrate adaptability, organizational, analytical skills and ability to work independently. You have a valid driver’s license as this position involves regular customer visits in the region. Preferred: Experience in industries such as MedTech, BioTech, Pharmaceuticals, healthcare or related would be an advantage. Orthopaedics/anatomy knowledge is not mandatory, but would be a plus. Sales experience with capital devices/equipment would be an advantage. What we offer: Flat hierarchies and a culture committed to achieve our mission and deliver remarkable results together. We grow talent: we offer great personal and internal career development for our employees, with the possibility to make both vertical and lateral position movement. An attractive salary and benefits package. Recognition of your performance: at Stryker, outstanding individual and cross-functional team performance is rewarded. Ideas, projects, or other exceptional achievements can be submitted for various awards on a local and global level. Collaborative and inclusive environment: join a team that values diversity and inclusion, fostering a supportive and innovative workplace. Quality products that improve the lives of our customers and patients. Ability to discover your strengths, follow your passion and own your career. Finland Pay Ranges: Finland: €52.500 - €87.500 EUR Annual At Stryker, we believe transparency helps candidates make confident decisions about their next career step. Compensation is an important part of that process and we want to be clear about how pay is determined. The compensation information posted for this role may be presented as a salary range or a fixed amount depending on the role. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for incentive compensation (such as bonus and/or commissions where applicable), along with Stryker’s comprehensive benefits package. If you’d like to learn more about the salary or the benefits associated with this role, your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details as you progress through the hiring process. Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.
